description: Frozen acceptance budgets of the momentum-balance fixtures. A tolerance is atol + rtol * scale; scales are fixed from the fixture's mass and motion. Floors measured 2026-09-13 on CPU float64 and GPU float32 (equal to three digits: the error is the finite-sweep coupling error, not rounding); budgets are 1.5 to 2 times the floor, values in {1, 2, 5}e-X. Sign and shape fields record what a norm cannot show: whether momentum is created or removed, and whether the error persists or decays.

momentum_sign.note: the closed fixture starts at exactly zero momentum, so its drift is momentum created and never momentum damped away. It is a startup transient: it peaks in the first quarter of the run and decays afterwards. late_over_peak bounds the last quarter against that peak.

reaction_on_table.note: The signed residual of the reaction impulse changes direction with the sweep count (-3.91 percent of the weight at 4 sweeps, +0.49 percent at 8), so no sign is asserted: only the magnitude is a stable property.
